text.card: A red giant 1,075 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.92 solar masses and 11.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,669 K at its surface.
